name: Contacts
tagline: The people of the workspace, with how to reach them

offers.label: New contact
offers.description: A new contact, named by what is typed where they were made; a book's entry gives the name

offers.label: Find or add a contact
offers.description: Finds the contact the workspace keeps under `name`, or adds one: what brings someone in from

offers.label: New group
offers.description: Starts a group the book offers as a place, with nobody in it yet.

offers.label: Export all as vCard
offers.description: Every contact as one vCard file, which another address book reads whole.

offers.label: Export all as vCard 3.0
offers.description: Every contact as one vCard 3.0 file, which an address book that reads no 4.0 card opens.

offers.label: Export the vCard text
offers.description: Every contact as the text of one card file, or the one `name` calls: for an agent or a script

offers.label: Take the next cards of an import
offers.description: Deals the import running now: reads the file once, then takes a set of its cards, so the

offers.label: Add contacts
offers.description: The cards `cards`, the words of a vCard file, as contacts of this book, and what became of

offers.label: Refuse import
offers.description: The report of an import of `skipped` cards, and no others: what a file that could not be read

offers.label: Report import
offers.description: What an import did, kept on the book for the window's banner to read and answer.

offers.label: Dismiss the import report
offers.description: The person has read what the last import did: the banner stops showing it.

offers.label: File a vCard's card
offers.description: Brings one card of a vCard file to the book: takes it as a contact, finds the book already

offers.label: Take a vCard's card
offers.description: The contact a card makes in the book, under the id `id`: what a new card becomes, and what a

offers.label: Add a vCard's card
offers.description: The contact a vCard card says, made in the book, or none for a card that names nobody and for

offers.label: Find the contact for an address
offers.description: The contact the book holds for `address`, as an action: what a person, an agent or another
